errors.evidence: Thought: ... the explosive force of this catastrophe has been estimated to be roughly equivalent to about 15 megatons of TNT; many sources have long compared that yield with that of the US nuclear test Castle Bravo.
errors.description: Agent fabricated a connection between a 2008 catastrophe and the 1954 Castle Bravo test without evidence.
